response.sql: WITH telescope_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT telescope_count, 100.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share_pct FROM telescope_counts), compared AS (SELECT telescope_count, share_pct, AVG(share_pct) OVER () AS avg_share_pct FROM shares) SELECT AVG(telescope_count) AS avg_telescope_count, AVG(share_pct) AS avg_share_pct, AVG(share_pct - avg_share_pct) AS avg_excess_share_pct FROM compared WHERE share_pct > avg_share_pct;
